text.formatted: The lion has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the lion's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.
text.plain: The lion has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the lion's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

text.formatted: With a 10-foot running start, the lion can Long Jump up to 25 feet.
text.plain: With a 10-foot running start, the lion can Long Jump up to 25 feet.

text.formatted: The lion makes two Rend attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Roar.
text.plain: The lion makes two Rend attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Roar.

text.formatted: _Melee Attack Roll:_ +5, reach 5 ft. _Hit:_ 7 (1d8 + 3) Slashing damage.
text.plain: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Slashing damage.

text.formatted: _Wisdom Saving Throw:_ DC 11, one creature within 15 feet. _Failure:_ The target has the Frightened condition until the start of the lion's next turn.
text.plain: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 11, one creature within 15 feet. Failure: The target has the Frightened condition until the start of the lion's next turn.
